value.text: Isaac's voiceover in Rebirth was done by Tallulah Bossi, Matthias Bossi (Member of Ridiculon and voice of Dad/Narrator) and Carla Kihlstedt's (Musician and voice of Mom) daughter.
For Repentance, the voice was done by their son, Viggo Bossi.
Contrary to previous theories made about Isaac, he does not have a sister.
Isaac is circumcised. This was confirmed by Edmund McMillen during a YouTube stream.
By around the events of The Binding of Isaac, Isaac was already homeschooled.
